```r
dt_raw_dat <- [fread](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/fread.html)(filename)
dat_long <- [melt](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/melt.data.table.html)(dt_raw_dat, 
 measure.vars = [which](https://rdrr.io/r/base/which.html)([names](https://rdrr.io/r/base/names.html)(dt_raw_dat) != "country"), 
 variable.name = "name", value.name = "value")
dat_long[, [c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)("year", "name", "name2") := 
 [tstrsplit](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/tstrsplit.html)(name, "_", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
dat_long[[is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(name2), name2 := ""]
dat_long[, name := [paste](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)(name, name2, sep = "_")][, name2 := NULL]
dat_wide <- [dcast](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/dcast.data.table.html)(dat_long, country + year ~ name, value.var = "value")
```
